key_concepts: Air is a mixture of gases that surrounds Earth.
Earth's atmosphere is a thick layer of air important to living things.
Gases in air are invisible but can be detected through their effects.
Every planet in the Solar System has some kind of atmosphere.
Planetary atmospheres vary from very thin exospheres to very dense gas giant atmospheres.
